Interface OwnerRef

All Known Implementing Classes:
OwnerRef.NestedOwner, OwnerRef.RootOwner
public sealed interface OwnerRef permits OwnerRef.RootOwner, OwnerRef.NestedOwner
The owner an Address is resolved relative to — the chain that lets a handle re-bind to the live backing each call (and that makes the held-handle "wrong/no screen" case a clean no-op: an owner that doesn't resolve against the live session yields the neutral default).
  • OwnerRef.RootOwner — bottoms out the chain at a menu family + scope.
  • OwnerRef.NestedOwner — a thing owned by another addressable (a panel element owned by its panel; a panel-in-panel). Composes to arbitrary depth; every chain terminates at a OwnerRef.RootOwner.

The owner level also IS the cascade scope: a group/inheritance default attached at an OwnerRef is inherited by every Address whose owner chain passes through it (the nesting gives panel→element inheritance for free). Pure value (record equality).

Sealed-extensible; FROZEN-OPEN like Token.
